title: Akiyama Mizuki — An Awaited Notification〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Still, don't you want to finish what we've been working on together...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <We'll let you know when we're about to upload it, so try to be there for that. I mean, it was a group effort...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <Then, I'll see what I can do...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <And I'll let you all know if I can't make it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It was only for a short while, but I'm glad we got some time to work together.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Plus, it sounded like she was feeling a little bit better towards the end there...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If we can keep up this pace and upload it by tomorrow... Oh, hold on...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Because I sorta suggested that we should try to finish everything when we're all together...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But you want to upload our video as soon as possible, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I was also hoping that we'd get to watch it go up as a group.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, despite how much studying she has to do, she got her lyrics done after working on it bit by bit.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<It's our music video. Yuki included...
So, if possible, I'd like to upload it when all four of us are present.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Okay, I'm really glad to hear that...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then, all that's left is for us to finish this video together♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<That's easier said than done...
I still have to draw that thing you wanted, and you have to actually put it into the video.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Haha. I haven't forgotten.
After all, I'm the one who came up with that idea.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, if you manage to finish it by next morning, I should be able to have everything done by noon.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hmm... If you're okay with the rough sketch I have now, then I should be able to...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Should...?
Can you put a number on that?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Like 70%...?
It sorta depends on whether or not I like what I draw.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What? That means you've totally got this, Enanan♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<No, I'm being serious♪
We all believe in you. Right, K?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I agree. I thought your sketch was good, so I'm sure you'll do well, Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <To be fair, my plan has been to do what I can now so that we can upload our video by tomorrow. So, I'll do my best.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <At the same time, I know you're a scary selfie girl, but can't you stop prickly towards me?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What?! How am I either of those things?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Whoa! My point exactly!
You're starting to scare me, so I'm gonna mute myself and get to work.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Despite her gripes, I have a feeling that Ena's gonna finish in time...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright...
I should also do what I can since I might've pressed a few too many buttons just now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see... The new cut's gonna start when the chorus does... So, around here...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll try dropping in Ena's sketch to see how it's all gonna work. After that...
